summary: The diff implements REQ-1 by creating a centered medications page layout using flexbox centering utilities (flex items-center justify-center) and max-width constraints. The implementation aligns with all acceptance criteria and respects the stated constraints regarding Design B theme system preservation and mobile-first responsiveness.

hallucinated_features.description: Complete medications management functionality including medication list, schedule tracking, 'Mark Taken' buttons, reminders section, and medication status indicators
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest non-goals explicitly state 'Creating a new medications page if one doesn't exist' and 'Changing the functionality or data of the medications feature'. The request was only to center-align existing content, not to implement full medication tracking features with interactive buttons and data management.

hallucinated_features.description: Route configuration for /medications path with full routing integration
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest non-goals explicitly state 'Modifying the navigation or routing structure'. The request was to center-align an existing page, not to add new routing configuration.

hallucinated_features.description: Navigation tile for Medications in Quick Actions section of Home dashboard
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints specify 'Do not modify the existing Design B theme system' and non-goals include 'Modifying the navigation or routing structure'. Adding navigation elements was not part of the center-alignment requirement.
